document:0:113:0.text: Place the <style="highlight">balm herring</style> and water in the pot, start by adding <style="highlight">snowgem juice</style> to eliminate the fishy smell, then follow with <style="highlight">fortis herbs</style> and <style="highlight">misted beanberries</style>. Simmer until the fish is thoroughly cooked.
document:0:113:0.source_cn: 将<style="highlight">香脂鲱</style>和清水放入锅中，先加入能去除腥味的<style="highlight">莹霜醋栗汁</style>，再依次加入<style="highlight">韧叶草</style>、<style="highlight">粉面豆果</style>，熬煮至鱼肉完全熟透。
